Then we can copy each .txt file to Archived_Quarter1. But we need to be in the parent directory to copy into Archived_Quarter1. So after listing, we can cd back up. So steps:

- mkdir Archived_Quarter1 (if not exist)
- cd Quarter1_Reports
- ls
- For each .txt file, cp file ../Archived_Quarter1/file
- cd ..
